about_the_game:
Make Your Country Dominate Again is a minimalist PvP Super MMO idle strategy game about the collective conquest of territory and the absorption of real-world countries.

Why "Super MMO"? Because players from all over the world — in unlimited numbers — exist on one single, monolithic map at the same time.

The player, an immaterial entity, uses their share of influence to help some nations consume others. Player actions are expressed through Arrows — to invade neighboring countries — and Flags — to defend their own. The entire world becomes a superposition of every player's input across the planet.

The main goal is to help your country conquer the entire world. That’s the victory condition.

Tactically, you focus on generating Energy through a system of Devices. The energy you produce represents your influence as a player in the world.

You monitor the charge level of your main Dynamo Machine — the core of your energy production — and strategically activate temporary boosters throughout the day.

The Dynamo Machine and other Devices can be upgraded to match your playstyle:

  • Stay active longer in offline mode

  • Generate more Energy during active play

  • Provide temporary boosters for sudden attacks

You can always reset the device upgrade tree and experiment with different configurations.

short_description: Welcome to a global multiplayer meat grinder. This is a strategy game where you don’t just win — you collectively erase countries from a single, shared world map. Only one nation is allowed to survive!
supported_languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
